title: NVIDIA reports over 1 million downloads for 5G and 6G open source tools
excerpt: Global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x over the past year.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on November 6, 2026, that its open source tools for 5G and 6G network development have surpassed 1 million downloads. The suite includes NVIDIA Aerial wireless software and NVIDIA Sionna, which are used by more than 8,000 research and academic institutions worldwide.

Researchers are utilizing these platforms to develop AI-native networks, including experiments in goal-oriented semantic communications and neural receivers. At King’s College London, researchers using NVIDIA Sionna reduced robot task completion time by up to 52.6% in experiments.

Tests by the University of Leeds using a 5G network-in-a-box resulted in a 45.6% reduction in RAN power consumption. Additionally, the Centre Tecnològic de Telecomunicacions de Catalunya reduced simulation runtime from approximately three hours to 10-20 minutes by using GPU-accelerated radio channel models.
topic: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
